news.title: Patch Notes — v0.7.0
news.shortDescription: Flooded City improvements, major graphics performance optimizations, and various bug fixes.
news.fullBody:
A big focus on Flooded City polish and performance this time around.

BUG FIXES
- Fixed a bug that rarely caused guinea pigs to appear outside the balloon
- Fixed a rare desync between host and client guinea pig animations
- Fixed a bug that caused the Skin and Outfit tabs to overlap in the customization panel
- Fixed a bug that prevented the virtual cursor from appearing for gamepad users on the Credits screen
- Fixed a bug that prevented the launch message from appearing for new players

IMPROVEMENTS
- Visual improvements to the Flooded City level
- The rolling boulder in Flooded City now moves slower, making it easier to escape
- Sinking platform timers in Flooded City have been adjusted based on player feedback
- Optimizations and fine-tuning to the server connection process for players with slower internet
- Various leaderboard improvements
- Reworked the Medium and Low graphics presets from the ground up — players on lower settings should see a solid FPS boost, especially on older GPUs
- Improved texture memory handling, reducing stutters and helping with map loading issues on lower-end PCs
- Optimized shadow rendering across all quality levels
- Adjusted level-of-detail distances so the game spends less time rendering things you can't actually see

Have a bug to report, a suggestion, or something you'd like to see in the game? Leave a review, use the in-game feedback button, or reach us on Discord. We read everything and do our best to make it happen.

— DVS Interactive

news.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together Supporter Pack

news.fullBody:
Want to help us keep rolling?

The Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack is now available. It includes exclusive cosmetic items and shows your support for an indie team of three working hard to make the best guinea pig co-op experience possible.

Every purchase goes directly back into development. Thank you for being part of this journey.
